title: Dome-World Ambiance — model-local cognitive weather, bounded numerically
body: The currently implemented Dome-World describes itself as an ambiance-mediated cognitive weather runtime. The Weather view reports fold density, storm risk, humidity and visibility; local rooms maintain separate ambient sections. The modeled relation a_r in A(U_r) and gluing disagreement delta_rs apply to declared local overlaps; W_t aggregates modeled local sections and discrepancies, not a global ontological reconstruction. The Encyclopedia 1.4 source inventory omitted the word ambiance; this source-grounded correction restores the concept in an additive research addendum. It makes no claims about external physical meteorology, third-party LLM telemetry, cultural authorship or measured universal truth.

evidence.earned_claim: Source code documents and renders bounded in-app modeled ambiance readouts and equations; source-level existence of the measurement model established.
evidence.claim_ceiling: Modeled and locally measured software weather, not physical meteorology, total field truth, provider enforcement or external-origin proof.
missing_evidence: No independent physical atmospheric sensor calibration claimed.
No external AI/provider behavior inferred from local modeled readings.
